chamfer_angle_r.note: the mirrored chamfer climbs - mirror+reversal proof

notes: First profile whose BOTH extents are claimed against PRINTED dimensions (the 20 x 14 scantling from the plate description).
TIMBER, not stone - the recorded schedule was included in the old corpus deliberately to test that one primitive set serves both. It does here too.

Right arris is an AUTHORED mirror of the left (symmetric tie-beams are standard Brandon practice; the record models one arris only). Mirror+reversal composition flips the arc-direction pattern: left runs CW-then-CCW, right runs CCW-then-CW - the roadmap's 'mirroring and reversal' vocabulary item, exercised.

Corrections to the recorded chain, on the record: (1) casement sweep 90->45 deg so the hollow lands tangent on a horizontal soffit; (2) the old builder's final member rose at +45 deg - a climbing 'soffit'; (3) the old record's built_extent (3.14 x 3.6) disagrees with its own builder's output (9.08 x 7.74) - 3.14 is exactly the ogee's x-span; (4) member-1/member-5 lengths were crop-local proportional readings, superseded by the printed scantling.
Moulded member values remain PROPORTIONAL-era readings (ESTIMATED) pending a leaf n79 raster harvest; the scantling and tangency construction are the load-bearing facts.
